newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Short-term PHIBOR rates rise sharply.
newsitem.headline: Short-term PHIBOR rates rise sharply.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose in all maturities, with the short-term rates tilting higher than long-term rates, traders said.

They attributed the unnatural PHIBOR curve to the Central Bank's raising of short-term rates and keeping the termed reverse repos unchanged. It raised its short-term rates to preempt speculative attacks on the Philippine peso after foreign funds sold down the Thailand baht late on Wednesday.
"We have a reverse yield curve because of Central Bank," one trader said, adding the yield curve would normalise once the speculation abated.
